static_rules.rule: Each completed modifier upgrade adds 5 Health, 5 Mana and 5 Capacity. A fully enhanced modifier grants one promotion point.
static_rules.qualification: Confirmed active Workshop QML binding; upgrade-vitals gameplay not measured.

static_rules.rule: Individual spell cooldown is at least half its base cooldown.
Higher cooldown-modifier grades add Momentum chance instead of further cooldown reduction.
Premium is required for Wheel and gem effects; free players can inspect a build.
Revelation Mastery contributes points to the associated Revelation domain.

native_observation.evidence: Fresh scrot screenshot displayed in tool output before server closed connection. Initial source PNG was overwritten by later screenshot and is not present in retained files.
native_observation.limitation: Gem identities, grades, placement and per-domain invested points were not yet inspected; this alone does not prove how gem mastery was calculated.

native_session_limitation: Remote host closed connection; character selection returned to empty-password login form. Needs user re-login for further interactive observation.
asset_retention: No client binaries, images, credentials or login screenshot are committed. The initial Wheel screenshot was observed but its source file was overwritten; it is not a reproducible retained image.

planner_comparison.grade_state: Planner comparison uses Grade IV for the four selected modifiers. The exported preset does not encode the native character Workshop grades; native HP/Energy readings therefore differ.
planner_comparison.qualification: Official planner UI reference, not a controlled native combat measurement.
